{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low in early horizons and overcorrect in longer horizons, showing lag where true prices mean-revert toward model values",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with price changes but model underestimates magnitude, especially when sentiment deviates from neutral",
    "Price reversal bias: model misses inflection points by 1-3 days, causing 2-5% accuracy degradation at 1-7 day horizons",
    "When prices are in uptrend, model bottoms are too high; when downtrend, model peaks are too low (trend lag)",
    "Sentiment strength correlates with forecast error magnitude - stronger sentiment signals produce larger model deviations",
    "Model exhibits mean-reversion bias at 8-14 day horizons while true prices maintain momentum",
    "Incorrect sentiment interpretation: model undervalues bullish effects when prices are already rising" ]}
